_doc: Groovy (Gradle scripts, Jenkins pipelines, Groovy classes). The grammar is loose, so the analysis is by name: a call (func) and every word is a use, a class is a command whose keyword word (@kw) is class, trait or enum, an interface one whose keyword is interface. private = private, no modifier = public (Groovy default). ref_cmd.include: Jenkins `load 'x.groovy'` and Gradle `apply from: 'x.gradle'` name a script of ours. roots.main: main and call are entries (a global step of a Jenkins shared library is `call`). path_roots: the files of a Jenkins shared library (vars/*.groovy, a src/ that is not the Maven/Gradle src/main or src/test) are called by name from pipelines in other repositories (hard); Gradle buildSrc and plugins are loaded by Gradle.
